task.title: Interacting with the Red Hat Quay database
task.shortdesc: To interact with the Red Hat Quay PostgreSQL database and troubleshoot authorization or authentication issues, you can exec into the database using oc exec for Red Hat Quay on OpenShift Container Platform or podman exec for standalone, then enter the PostgreSQL shell with psql.

note.p: Interacting with the PostgreSQL database is potentially destructive. Red Hat recommends that you perform the following procedure with a Red Hat Quay Support Specialist.
Interacting with the PostgreSQL database can also be used to troubleshoot authorization and authentication issues.
